brief:
Israel's President Isaac Herzog accepted the results of the recent elections and opened talks on forming a new government, Al Jazeera English reported. The move undermines Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's efforts to challenge the election outcome, in which he and his political allies lost their parliamentary majority.

Herzog's acceptance of the vote represents a critical step toward transitioning power away from Netanyahu's coalition. The president's decision to proceed with government formation talks signals that Israel's electoral process will move forward despite Netanyahu's attempts to question its legitimacy.
dek: Move deals blow to Netanyahu's efforts to discredit the elections, in which he and his allies lost their majority.
title: Herzog accepts election results, begins government formation talks
